name: @hh/chat-thread
description: Renderer and Electron adapter for Chat UI

scripts.build:desktop: npm --prefix ../database run build && npm --prefix ../provider run build && npm --prefix ../session run build && vite build --config vite.desktop.config.ts
scripts.build:plugin: npm run build:embed && npm run build:desktop
scripts.dist: npm run build && npm run build:desktop && electron dist/desktop/app.cjs
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix ../database run build && npm --prefix ../provider run build && npm --prefix ../session run build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json
